written.headline: Anthropic adds rule to stop Claude Code from cloning existing video games
written.summary: Anthropic updated Claude Code’s system prompt to forbid recreating specific games, adding a rule that allows only original or genre‑based games. The change was first spotted on Oct 27 and confirmed by engineer Addy Osmani.

written.headline: Qodo adds company knowledge to Codex for pre‑pull‑request code review
written.summary: Qodo integrates its internal coding standards and knowledge into OpenAI's Codex, enabling developers to detect priority‑0 issues across repositories before opening a pull request.

written.headline: xAI launches Data Bot, a team AI assistant for data queries at SpaceX
written.summary: xAI introduced Data Bot, a Team Bot built into Grok Bot that can query SpaceX’s data warehouse, run analyses, and return results in chat or dashboards. The bot is shared across teams and can be added to Slack channels.

written.headline: AI agent selects gene therapy and performs brain injection on live mouse
written.summary: An AI agent running on Anthropic’s Claude Sonnet 5 chose a gene‑therapy vector, brain region and injection coordinates, then controlled a motorized surgical rig to inject 250 nanolitres into a mouse model of epilepsy. A licensed veterinarian approved each irreversible step and held a physical kill switch, and the agent stopped when it detected a calibration error.

written.headline: GPT-6 Astra edits 0.016% of Qwen3.5-0.8B weights, boosting math performance sixfold
written.summary: Researchers used GPT-6 Astra to edit the weights of the Qwen3.5-0.8B language model. The edit changed 0.016% of the weights and reportedly improved math reasoning up to six times and instruction following three times, without gradients or additional training.
